rating_note: Voltage pass does not qualify source continuous current, connector/harness, thermal or transient behavior. Five moderate examples draw below 10 A; no example specifically targets a solved 10 A input. Three 8.9 A servo-only examples draw more than 11 A after electronics/conversion.
source_condition: One ideal 7.4 V external BEC terminal; explicit unmeasured feed/contact resistances. All share J10/J11 receiver loads of 1 A each.
